title: No return-type annotation needed, even though it's recursive
prompt: What does this return? Work it out by reading it, then reveal the answer.

given.script:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
fun sumAll(v) = v match {
  case o is Object -> sum(o pluck ((value) -> sumAll(value)))
  case a is Array -> sum(a map ((item) -> sumAll(item)))
  case n is Number -> n
  else -> 0
}
---
sumAll(payload)

explanation.approach: `fun sumAll(v) = ...` declares neither the parameter's type nor the return type, and it still compiles and recurses correctly.
